description: This file defines an interface 'JsonNull' used to represent JSON null values within the project, providing default behavior for writing a null value and estimating string size.

classes.name: JsonNull
classes.description: Interface to indicate classes representing a JSON null value, with default methods for serialization and size estimation.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Default method to write a JSON null value using the provided serialization context.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Default method returning the estimated maximum string size for the JSON null representation.
